name: Ice Skating Rink Rentals Default Theme
description: Local development theme for Ice Skating Rink Rentals.

classNames.root: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b border-sky-100 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md
classNames.container: max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-8 flex items-center justify-between h-16
classNames.logoText: text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-950 tracking-tight group-hover:text-sky-700 transition-colors
classNames.nav: hidden md:flex items-center gap-7 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600
classNames.ctaButton: hidden md:inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2 bg-sky-700 text-white text-sm font-bold rounded-full hover:bg-sky-800 transition-all shadow-sm

footer.copyright: Copyright {year} Ice Skating Rink Rentals. All rights reserved.
footer.description: Portable Ice Rink Rentals for events, seasonal activations, venues, and private celebrations.

classNames.container: max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-8 py-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-8
classNames.columnTitle: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-sky-200 mb-3
classNames.bottomBarInner: max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-8 py-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400

Hero.headline: max-w-3xl text-4xl font-extrabold leading-tight text-slate-950 md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl
Hero.subheadline: mt-5 max-w-2xl text-base leading-8 text-slate-700 md:text-lg
Hero.button: inline-flex min-h-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-sky-700 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-lg shadow-sky-900/15 transition-colors hover:bg-sky-800

CardGrid.title: text-3xl font-extrabold leading-tight text-slate-950 md:text-4xl
CardGrid.subtitle: mt-3 text-base leading-7 text-slate-600 md:text-lg
CardGrid.card: rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md

HowItWorks.title: mb-10 text-3xl font-extrabold leading-tight text-slate-950 md:text-4xl
HowItWorks.step: rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm

PrimaryCTA.title: text-3xl font-extrabold leading-tight text-white md:text-4xl
PrimaryCTA.button: inline-flex min-h-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-sky-800 shadow-lg transition-colors hover:bg-sky-50
